Second NEXUS budget-planning session to convert summer decisions into final-quarter commitments, update closure forecasts and prepare initial scenarios for 2027.

Clara Ibáñez: In June, we separated committed, conditional and scenario items. Several decisions now have formal resolutions.
Rosa Mena: As of 31 August, expenditure is 68 percent for SILEX, 59 percent for LUMEN, 56 percent for VERDANT and 49 percent for ARIADNA.
Javier Ortega: The SILEX pilot is confirmed for the week beginning 9 November. Pre-production support, the stable environment and pilot-week support must now become commitments.
Lucía Navarro: Yara's extension through 30 September is signed. LUMEN demonstrator validation and publication preparation are also confirmed.
Andrés Beltrán: VERDANT is already operating with six facilities. Continuation through November depends on the monthly review, but monitoring and security costs are current commitments.
Elena Martín: ARIADNA v2.1 is approved and internally released. v2.2 work must be funded as maintenance, not as a repetition of official evaluation.
Nuria Castaño: Atlas-2 capacity is sufficient, although exclusive windows must be reserved for SILEX, VERDANT and reproducible ARIADNA and LUMEN images.
Rosa Mena: I propose year-end forecasts of 94 percent for SILEX, 87 percent for LUMEN, 83 percent for VERDANT and 78 percent for ARIADNA, with room for November adjustments.
Clara Ibáñez: Final-quarter reserves are approved. The 2027 scenarios will include data maintenance, storage, pilot support and possible expansions only when supported by a new decision.
Elena Martín: The table will continue to show when each item moved from conditional to committed.
